assertions.description: galen-morning-snapshot skill-run signal file was written
galen-morning-snapshot skill-run did not end in failure

Galen G1 (data-integrity honesty): the longitudinal health metrics store exists and is the file Galen reads/writes. Honest limit: whether a given run correctly declared a WHOOP source unavailable/stale and refused to interpolate is a semantic judgment (it depends on the live token state at run time) and is covered by the G4 Tier 3 grade — no mechanical check can tell a declared-unavailable source from a silently-fabricated value.

Galen G4 (Tier 3 grade >= B): morning-snapshot quality, including G1 data-integrity honesty, is judged by Tier 3 grading. Honest alternative — grade presence at B or better; defers (skipped) until graded.
